versionStatus.officialChangeListTitle: 10.13.2026 update Battle Change List | Buckler's Boot Camp | STREET FIGHTER 6 | CAPCOM
versionStatus.caveat: The current frame page does not expose an explicit game build number. This snapshot records the official live table and observed change-list date, not a verified build identifier.

parsing.notation: Directions use numeric keypad notation for a character facing right. P/K mean any punch/kick; LP/MP/HP/LK/MK/HK mean strength-specific buttons. Repeated P P / K K are simultaneous inputs as shown by adjacent official icons; > is the official sequential arrow. Empty strings retain blank official cells. D is the official knockdown marker. inputHtml retains exact official input markup.
warnings: Official values and notes are preserved verbatim as research evidence; they are not normalized or corrected.
Some official notes and aggregate values can be internally inconsistent; verify in-game before claiming exact behavioral parity.
parsing.activeFrameInterpretation: active and activeSummary are the displayed summary range; activeSegments preserve discontinuous active hit windows from official tooltips where available. The summary range must never be treated as continuous hitbox activity. activeRawHtml and activeRawText preserve original evidence.
parsing.propertiesInterpretation: propertiesRawText and propertiesRawHtml preserve official labels. Jumping Heavy Kick contains a duplicated Mid label in official markup; properties deduplicates that label to Mid.
parsing.damageInterpretation: No explicit Drink-Level damage baseline statement was found in the table heading or surrounding frame-page text. Damage cells are preserved exactly; do not automatically multiply or import them as final damage without in-game verification. SA1 asterisk variants are separately enumerated.

rows.name: Perfect Parry (strike)
rows.inputHtml: Block Direction MM
rows.notes:
Perfect Parry activates when an attack is absorbed on the frame a parry is input, or on the next frame. (For high and overhead attacks, the player must press the direction away from the opponent. For low attacks, down and back)
If no direction is inputted the result will be a regular parry with an additional Drive increase of 3000.
Fully invincible for 5 frames once recovery is over (invincibility not granted if you continue the parry)
The player on the receiving end of a Perfect Parry cannot cancel and is forced into a Punish Counter state until their move is finished

rows.name: Perfect Parry (projectile)
rows.inputHtml: MM
rows.notes:
Perfect Parry activates when an attack is absorbed on the frame a parry is input, or on the next frame
No screen freeze occurs.
The player on the receiving end of a Perfect Parry cannot cancel and is forced into a Punish Counter state until their move is finished

supplementaryOfficialEvidence.finding: When The Devil's Song ends, the Drink Level returns to the value that existed before activation, per the February 27, 2024 adjustment. No subsequent official Jamie SA2 change was found in the update history checked through October 13, 2026.
After Back Shaver connects, continue holding the throw input to perform the drink-raising follow-up.
Intoxicated Assault second attack can special-cancel; final attack wall-splats when reaching the corner. The October 13, 2026 list has no Jamie-specific entry.
The official Fighting Ground HUD manual sets a maximum of three stocks and says unused gauge carries over to the next round.
